$comment: Hard geometry contract for AI image generation. Read design-spec.json for the full measured model; this file is the subset that MUST NOT be violated, with tolerances and a checkable validation list. Units: inches.
contract: The generator owns light and material. It does NOT own geometry. Any output that violates a rule below is rejected regardless of how good it looks.

hardRules.rule: Vanity cabinet width is exactly 36.0 in
hardRules.failure: Cabinet stretched to fill the wall

hardRules.rule: Vanity cabinet depth is exactly 12.0 in
hardRules.failure: Cabinet drawn as deep as the basin

hardRules.rule: Vanity cabinet height is 20.0 in, underside at 9.0 in AFF

hardRules.failure: Basin centred, or channel closed up

hardRules.rule: Basin is flush with the cabinet's LEFT end, not centred
Basin and landing project 13.8 in, 1.8 in proud of the cabinet
hardRules.failure: Basin flush with the cabinet face

hardRules.rule: Basin rim at 36.0 in AFF, cabinet top at 29.0 in AFF
Splash panel is 60.0 in wide, centred on the cabinet
hardRules.failure: Splash cropped to the cabinet width

hardRules.rule: Mirror is a stadium/pill — both short ends fully semicircular
hardRules.failure: Rounded rectangle instead of a pill

hardRules.rule: Mirror is centred on the 60 in SPLASH, not on the offset basin
Two identical VERTICAL sconces flank the mirror; no bar light above it
hardRules.failure: Horizontal bar light above the mirror

hardRules.rule: Taps are WALL-mounted, 3-piece: spout centred between two cross handles
Exactly one metal appears: copper. No mixed finishes
Baseboard runs CONTINUOUSLY and passes UNDER the wall-hung vanity
Shower back wall sits 14.5 in behind the vanity wall; the step is visible
Door opening starts at x = 110.5 in, the right edge of the vanity wall
hardRules.failure: Door floated away from the wall edge

hardRules.rule: Tub rim at 20.0 in AFF; tub is 60 x 32 in
hardRules.failure: Tub scaled to fill the bay

hardRules.rule: Wall niche is RECESSED 4 in INTO the wall; it never projects

forbidden: Adding, removing, resizing or moving any fitting listed in design-spec.json
Wide-angle or fisheye distortion — 35 mm equivalent only
Invented fixtures, extra shelves, extra niches, second mirrors
Styling props: plants, towels, bottles, trays, people
Text, watermarks, dimension annotations baked into the image
Glossy CGI plastic surfacing, HDR halos, blown highlights
generatorOwns: Light: direction, softness, colour temperature, contact shadows
Material response: reflectance, roughness, veining detail, grout depth
Atmosphere: grain, depth of field, overall grade

validation.method: Score each hardRule against the output. Any FAIL means regenerate — do not accept and do not average across attempts.
validation.checklist: Read left to right along the vanity wall: 36 cabinet? basin flush left? 1.5 channel visible? landing stepped up right? splash wider than the cabinet? pill mirror centred on the splash? two vertical sconces? wall taps, 3-piece? baseboard passing under? step visible at the shower?

workflow.1: Lock a version in the planner. The 3D reads the locked version, not working edits.
workflow.2: Open Bathroom 3D.html, orbit to the view, screenshot. That plate IS the geometry.
workflow.3: Send plate + design-spec.json + this file + AI-SYSTEM-PROMPT.md to the generator.
workflow.5: Log failures in the planner's defect log, press PATCH PROMPT WITH LOG, regenerate.
